module: Facade used by the UI's "game modes" tab. Depending on whether a multiplayer session exists (multiplayer_sessionManager.getCurrentSession() non-nil), calls are redirected to multiplayer_uiBackend_multiplayerUIManager, otherwise to gameplay_multiseat_gamemodeManager (split screen). Each function checks that the target module is loaded and does nothing otherwise.
notes: restartGamemode does nothing in a network session; selectGamemode, deselectGamemode, startReadyUp, stopReadyUp, setOwnerPreReadyRole and requestSetOwnGamemodeRole do nothing outside a network session.

requestGamemodeData.desc: Requests that the game mode data be sent to the UI (requestMultiplayerTabData on network, requestGamemodeData in split screen).

startGamemode.desc: Starts a game mode (multiplayerUIManager.startGamemode or gamemodeManager.start).

settings.desc: Mode settings (inferred from code: passed as is).

stopGamemode.desc: Stops the current game mode (stopGamemode on network, stop in split screen).

restartGamemode.desc: Restarts a game mode in split screen (gamemodeManager.restart). No effect in a network session.

selectGamemode.desc: Network only: the host selects a mode (selectGamemodeForOwner).

deselectGamemode.desc: Network only: the host deselects the mode (deselectGamemodeForOwner).

startReadyUp.desc: Network only: starts the players' "ready" phase for a mode.

gamemodeInfo.desc: Mode information (inferred from code: passed as is).

setOwnerPreReadyRole.desc: Network only: sets the host's role before the "ready" phase.

role.desc: Role (inferred from code: passed as is).

requestSetOwnGamemodeRole.desc: Network only: requests to change one's own role in the game mode.

role.desc: Requested role (inferred from code: passed as is).
